fields.name: SqlConnectionConfiguration connection-resolution library surface
fields.contract: SqlConnectionConfiguration accepts up to four ambient SQL Server property layers (global, shard-set, read/write, and shard) and local properties. It exposes an operation that returns the resolved SQL Server connection string and a property that returns the resolved endpoint description. Later applicable layers take precedence over earlier layers; its local properties take final precedence. A change to a local property, a change reported by a currently supplied ambient layer, or a new SetAmbientConfiguration call invalidates both the cached connection string and the cached description, so the next request of either resolves again; a repeated SetAmbientConfiguration call detaches from the previously supplied layers.
